content.text: BAWIPA koe lunghawi lawk dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahni teh ahawi.
A lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Cathut pueng e Cathut koe lunghawi lawk dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Bawi pueng e Bawi koe lunghawi lawk dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Kângairu hno kalen heh amadueng ka sak e koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
A lungangnae hoi kalvan ka sak koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh
a yungyoe a kangning.

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh
a yungyoe a kangning.

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Isarelnaw hah hote tuipui lungui hoi ka cet sakkung koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Faro siangpahrang hoi a ransanaw teh,
tui dawk koung ka tâkhawng koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
A miphunnaw hah thingyei yawn dawk ka cetkhaikung koe,

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
A min kamthang e siangpahrangnaw kathetkung koe,

Amor siangpahrang Sihon ka thet koe,

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
San hah Isarelnaw râw lah kapoekung koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Maimouh bo awh lahun nah, pou na kapoukung koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
Maimanaw heh taran um hoi na karasatkung koe,
bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.

bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
